requirements.text: A Cristal package has a class named Condition.
A Cristal package has one or more CompositeParDef.
The ElementaryPartDef class of a Cristal.
The Cristal model has Activity Definitions.
The cristal model has Part Definitions.
The Cristal model has Part Composite Members
The Condition class of a Cristal may have one or more PartCompositeMember.
The CompositeParDef of a Cristal may be composed by one or more PartCompositeMember.
The CompositeActDef of a Cristal may may be composed by one or more ActCompositeMembers
The ActCompositeMember of a Cristal may have one or more ActivityDefinition.
The ActivityDefinition of a Cristal has exactly one ActCompositeMember.
The PartDefinition node has any number of PartCompositeMember nodes. Each such node has one PartDefinition node.
The PartCompositeMember is a member of a unique PartDefinition of the Cristal model.
